headline: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 as a multimodal, real-time interactive world-model research preview
summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on Oct 27, 2026 and said a research preview had begun for trusted testers, with initial access through Project Genie for Google AI Ultra subscribers and early-access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The company describes real-time natural-language scene changes, generated audio and dialogue, and qualitative tester exploration. Its product page shows an in-loop Gemini/Genie robotics-simulation example but reports no measured task outcome. DeepMind says continuous interactions currently last only a few minutes; visual details and object permanence can drift; accurate real-location simulation and complex interaction among independent agents in shared environments remain research challenges. It also says showcase sequences are shortened and illustrative. The 2025 Genie 3 announcement had specified 24 frames per second and 720p; the Genie 4 materials reviewed here give no directly comparable rate/resolution or matched benchmark. No model card, public code, independent evaluation or measured downstream outcome was inspected.
